issues: Request specified nav-materia-prima, nav-equipamentos, nav-ficha-tecnica, nav-tabela-preco but actual code uses nav-mp, nav-eq, nav-ficha, nav-tabela. Inconsistency between Layout.jsx and spec

action_items: Align sidebar nav data-testids: rename to nav-materia-prima, nav-equipamentos, nav-ficha-tecnica, nav-tabela-preco (or update spec). Currently uses nav-mp/nav-eq/nav-ficha/nav-tabela.
Investigate why clicking sidebar items does not navigate to the corresponding route (URL remains /dashboard). Verify <Link>/useNavigate wiring in Layout.jsx.
Add data-testid='pedidos-novo-btn' to the 'Novo Pedido' button on Pedidos page.
Verify login submit button onClick triggers handleSubmit (may need type='submit' or rely on form onSubmit which currently works only via Enter on first attempt).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 838 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, cadastros, ficha, pedidos, dre) for maintainability (>700 lines threshold).
DRE date filter uses ISO string comparison on created_at which is stored as ISO string - works but lexicographic; ensure all created_at are timezone-aware ISO.
Faturamento_6m uses timedelta(days=i*30) which is imprecise for month boundaries - can produce duplicate/missing months.
delete_produto removes ficha but not the produto's references in pedidos (already guarded). OK.
Markup descricao is unique globally across INDICE+LUCRO groups - might cause conflicts if same name used in both groups.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and clean up TEST_ prefixed data automatically
